findings.issue: Claimed A6 session-goal/task/phase evidence preservation has no visible user path. #sessionArea is permanently display:none!important, navigation to the operations view is hidden, and the evidence sessions tab only shows legacy p.sessions IDs/event counts rather than model.operations session goals, lifecycle/completion and task links.
findings.required_fix: Expose existing operations session evidence within the separate evidence sessions tab or another existing evidence route; preserve person/project scoping and distinguish lifecycle from goal completion. Verify session goal -> linked task -> phase/evidence path. Keep the basic minimal IA unchanged.

findings.issue: Selected person is held only in ownerFilter DOM state. Queue URLs encode project/view but no person, and no persisted filter restoration exists. Bob-scoped attention therefore becomes all-person attention after a reload/new tab, violating the explicit reload filter-preservation requirement.
findings.required_fix: Persist and restore the selected person safely, or encode the scope in navigation state/URL with validation. Add a fresh-runtime reload test rather than only applyChanges on the same DOM.

findings.issue: Documentary rows skip the explicit-owner filter because it is guarded by !d. If a document task supplies owner Alice, a Bob-scoped queue will still present 담당 Alice as a requested action. Missing owners may remain project scoped, but explicit other-owner requests must respect person scope.
findings.required_fix: Apply the explicit-owner filter to both current and documentary requests; add a documentary shared-project Alice/Bob counterexample.

aligned_points: Multi-user/shared project goals remain primary and all phases remain visible under person scope.
Plan-order text avoids fabricated dependency/date/ETA; conservative current model values unchanged in executed regression cases.
Separate read-only attention displays declared action and basis; documentary blockers show date/source and current runner acceptance unconfirmed.
Basic Phase detail retains the three requested fields plus a bounded next-decision summary.
Native links, ordered list and responsive CSS are present; source evidence is insufficient to judge actual rendered visual quality.
